The movie turns 10 today!!!
Another movie that's nearly flawless 
Love George Clooney, Judy Greer, Robert Forster, and my first introduction to Shailene Woodley 
Loved how they took a simple premise and turned it into something massive 
Absolutely one of Clooney's best performances 
the acting is stupendous, especially from young Shailene Woodley as the rebellious daughter
as always the scenery in Hawaii is magnificent
"The Descendants" also hits that right amount of emotion and you really feel for these characters
Alexander Payne handles this material well from the acclaimed book
this is another one of my favorites of 2011
